notes:
Lead: Head of Product (Sarah Nguyen). Evaluating Hosted API first for quick integration, then move to Dedicated if unit economics work out. Very cost-sensitive — growth stage SaaS with strict gross margin targets. Wants predictable per-session cost under $0.03/token-equivalent for customer-facing chat; embeddings budget is tighter (target < $5k/mo for initial indexing). Interested in Redwood Optimize workshop to tune batching/caching and choose a quantization profile that keeps quality loss < 2% on our NLU evals.

Key quotes: 'We need predictable token economics more than bleeding edge quality' — S. Nguyen.

Security: Must demonstrate SOC2 + SSO (Okta) before procurement. Data residency: US-only for customer PII; legal requested addendum.

POC scope: integrate Hosted chat endpoint into product beta (2k DAU simulated), run latency SLO at p95 < 300ms, compare throughput and cost vs Dedicated baseline. After successful Hosted run, Redwood to spin a small Dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) for 1-week soak with caching and batching enabled. Objective: measure tokens/sec, p95 latency, and per-1M-token cost across 3 model variants (open-llama-70b-q8, redwood-llm-13b-quantized, commercial-compat).

Commercial considerations: prefer monthly reserved capacity with option to burst; procurement asks for pricing floor + overage. They asked for a worked example of unit economics at 100k, 500k, 1M monthly generated tokens. Redwood AE to provide two pricing scenarios (hosted vs Dedicated reserved + commit).

requirements_summary: Workload: chat for end-users + embeddings for doc search
Targets: p95 chat latency < 300ms; throughput target 150 requests/sec peak; embeddings indexing < 48h for 500k docs
Cost sensitivity: strict — want per-session cost E2E below $0.03; embedding budget < $5k/mo for pilot
Model prefs: open/quantized variants preferred; allow fallback to hosted commercial model for critical low-latency paths
Routing: prefer region affinity US-East with cross-region fallback for DR
Operational: prefer pinned model versions and rollout canary for new prompts
poc_details: Duration: 4 weeks with two phases: Hosted integration (1 week soak) then Dedicated soak (2 weeks, including 1 week of autoscaling tests)
Success metrics: p95 latency, tokens/sec, model quality regression <2% on NLU eval, cost per 1M tokens <= target tier
Technical tasks: integrate SDK, enable streaming, wire prefix caching, run Redwood Optimize suggestions, capture traces for Console
workshop_findings: Batching: moving to dynamic batching with 50ms coalescing improved throughput by ~2.3x in test harness
Caching: prefix/KV caching for common prompts cut token counts by estimated 18% in prototype
Quantization: initial int8 caused 4% quality drop on intent classification; q4_0 maintained quality within 1.2% and reduced cost ~28%
Unit economics: projected per-1M-token cost (hosted) $420–$580 depending on model. Dedicated with 3-month commit projected $260–$360 per 1M tokens after caching/batching
